name: Skeleton
usage: Partial loading in message lists, cards and panels

props.name: active
props.description: Animates the placeholder with a shimmer.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Shows a round placeholder for an avatar before the text.

props.name: title
props.description:
Placeholder of a title line; `false` hides it, the object form sets its width (a number in pixels or a CSS
length such as `'50%'`).

props.name: paragraph
props.type: boolean | { readonly rows?: number readonly width?: number | string | readonly (number | string)[] }
props.description:
Placeholder of the paragraph; `false` hides it, the object form sets the number of `rows` and their `width`
(one value for the last row, or one per row).

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows the placeholder while true and `children` afterwards. Without `children`, the placeholder is always
shown.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown once loading has finished (when `loading` is false).

props.name: immediate
props.description:
Shows the placeholder immediately, without the 200 ms delayed appearance. Only use it when the skeleton is
controlled by useDelayedPending and mounted only while that is true, so the delay is not applied twice.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: A placeholder while part of the content loads; the first load of a whole page uses PageSkeleton.

examples.name: WithAvatar
examples.title: Avatar and paragraph
examples.description: For content with an avatar, such as messages and comments.
